context.description: Step 02a: Implement IDN-05 Named role registry backend — migration, TenantRoleStore module, GET/POST /roles API, EE-03 ROLE resolution integration.

task.description:
Implement IDN-05 per the approved design at src/design/idn05-role-registry.md. Steps:

1. Run codegen_migration.py on templates/specs/idn05-tenant-role.migration.yaml to generate the migration SQL file (migrations/1154_idn05_tenant_role_registry.sql or next available number). Verify it compiles with zig build migrate.

2. Run codegen_crud_endpoint.py on templates/specs/idn05-roles.crud-endpoint.yaml to generate scaffolding. Then complete the full implementation:
   - src/roles/ directory with TenantRoleStore (listRoles, upsertRole functions)
   - GET /roles handler: list all role bindings for calling tenant, RBAC gate (PROCESS_DESIGNER or PLATFORM_ADMIN)
   - POST /roles handler: create/update binding; validate group_id exists (HTTP 404 if not); RBAC gate
   - Wire routes in src/router.zig (or equivalent)

3. Integrate into EE-03 task activation:
   - Add resolveRoleInTx function to TenantRoleStore
   - In the HUMAN_TASK activation path: if assignee_type=ROLE, look up role name in tenant_role table; if found set group_id; if NOT found, create task in PENDING status (no error — mirrors 'group with no current members' edge case)
   - Follow the design §4 algorithm exactly

4. Validate:
   - zig build (must exit 0)
   - zig build test (must exit 0)
   - python tools/lint_sql_param_types.py (must exit 0)
   - python tools/lint_test_isolation.py (must exit 0)
   - python tools/lint_handoffs.py (must exit 0)
   - Commit all changes to feature/WF02-idn05-20260812 with message: feat(IDN-05): named role registry and ROLE assignee resolution

This is backend-only; no frontend changes needed. Frontier note: this is a new module — use the same patterns as IDN-02 (groups) for the store structure.

Do NOT implement anything not in the design. Do NOT touch unrelated files.
